items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: I see like they made this boy, what's it called, Honey Boy, what's it called this kid? ... Little Honey Child.

ctx.x: He was that small, he'd have to stand on two Coca-Cola box to get to play the piano. That's right. I see like they made this boy, what's it called, Honey Boy, what's it called this kid?

Little Honey Child. Well if things in them days was like they is now, you know modern and people getting good breaks like they're getting out of a bar, I guess they would have made a million dollars. You know on television and everything else.
